Other second-generation gravitational- wave observatories, such as Advanced Virgo [5], the Kamioka Gravitational-wave detector (KAGRA) [6, 7], and LIGO India [8], will soon join Advanced LIGO, helping to better constrain the sky location and the properties of observed gravitational waves’ sources
